_comment: PROPOSED mapping of core lessons to a representation family. Authored for the motion audit (docs/motion-audit.md); it assigns a family to a lesson, never a standard, objective or alignment. Lessons whose pairing is judgement-dependent are listed under `flags` for review. status: implemented = the family's lesson-specific model ships in Practice + Challenge + Family; planned = designed, not built; n/a = no applicable motion model (mindset lessons).

exponent-copies.title: Exponent copies (base copies of the previous block)
exponent-copies.planned: Copies grid with per-copy tint, multiplication labels, expanded form, notation annotations, misconception check.

fraction-partition-count.title: Fraction division by a unit fraction: partition and count
fraction-partition-count.planned: Bar of whole(s) cut into unit-fraction pieces then counted; stacked-fraction notation (never inline a ÷ b/c).

ratio-double-line-table.title: Ratios: double number line plus ratio table
ratio-double-line-table.planned: Double number line and ratio table moving together; each scaled row keeps both lines aligned.

ratio-graph.title: Ratios on the coordinate plane
ratio-graph.planned: Ratio-table rows plotted as points; line through the origin drawn as rows are added.

unit-conversion-chain.title: Unit conversion as a chain of ratios
unit-conversion-chain.planned: Fraction-tile chain where units cancel step by step.

percent-tape-grid.title: Percent: tape diagram and 100-grid
percent-tape-grid.planned: Tape and hundred-grid shading in sync with the percent equation.

expression-fee-not-multiplied.title: Expressions: a fixed fee that is not multiplied (12t + 50)
expression-fee-not-multiplied.planned: t groups of 12 plus one separate 50; t changes, 50 does not scale.

area-model.title: Area models (decimal products, distributive property)
area-model.planned: Rectangle split into partial products that sum to the whole.

long-division.title: Long division, one step at a time
long-division.planned: Place-value partition of the dividend with each quotient digit animated.

decimal-place-value.title: Decimal add and subtract in place-value columns

statistics-displays.title: Statistics displays (dot plot, histogram, box plot, balance)
statistics-displays.planned: Display built from the data; median, mean and spread markers move with the data.

geometry-area.title: Area of polygons by decomposition and recomposition
geometry-area.planned: Cut-and-rearrange animation from the existing StudioViz shape figures.

prism-volume-surface.title: Rectangular prisms: volume layers and surface-area faces
prism-volume-surface.planned: Layers of unit cubes (volume) and unfolded faces (surface area).

nets-solids.title: Nets and solids
nets-solids.planned: Net folds into the solid; each face counted once.

factors-multiples.title: Factors, multiples, primes
factors-multiples.planned: Hops on a number line meeting at the LCM; factor tree growth.

number-line.title: Integers, rational numbers and absolute value on the number line
number-line.planned: Opposites mirror about zero; absolute value as distance travelled.

coordinate-transformations.title: Coordinate plane, distance and reflections
coordinate-transformations.planned: Point or polygon moves to its image; axes as mirror; distance as counted steps.

equation-balance.title: Equations as a balance
equation-balance.planned: Same operation applied to both sides, balance stays level.

inequality-graph.title: Inequalities on the number line
inequality-graph.planned: Open or closed circle and ray built from the inequality.

two-variable-table-graph.title: Two-variable relationships: table, graph, equation
two-variable-table-graph.planned: Rows fill the table and plot together; the equation fits every row.

mindset-n-a.title: Mathematical-practice and mindset lessons (no mathematical model)
mindset-n-a.planned: None. Units 1 and 10 carry MPP/5th-grade review standards; motion would not add instructional value.

flags: 6-14 appears under area-model; Reveal places it with expressions. Review whether the area model or the 12t+50 family leads.
3-9 'Equivalent Ratios' reuses ratio tables from 3-3; confirm it should share the family rather than get a distinct one.
Unit 1 lessons 1-2 to 1-5 carry grade-5 standards (5.NF.B.4, 5.NBT.B.7, 5.MD.C.5, 5.OA.B.3). Left n/a; they have no Practice studio today.
